<!--
THE WHOLE-MATRIX VERSION of Figure 4's distortion. The body figure reports the distortion one
parameter at a time (the diagonal ratio, per k_off / per N_ch). This collapses the ENTIRE distortion
matrix M = G^{-1/2} J G^{-1/2} into a single scalar per cell: its affine-invariant (Rao/Fisher-Rao)
distance to the identity,

    d_AI(M, I) = sqrt( sum_i (log lambda_i)^2 ),   lambda_i = eigenvalues of M.

d = 0 is perfect calibration (M = I, reported covariance equals the truth in every direction). It is
the natural Riemannian metric on SPD matrices, so it is reparameterisation-invariant and weights
over- and under-confidence symmetrically (a factor 2 and a factor 1/2 are the same distance). Unlike
the diagonal ratio it accounts for the OFF-diagonal miscalibration too: an algorithm can be calibrated
per-parameter yet rotate the confidence ellipsoid, and only a whole-matrix metric sees that.

COMPUTED FROM THE AGGREGATE MATRIX, not from the emitted scalar (changed 2026-07-24). The battery also
emits Affine_Invariant_Distance directly, but that scalar is the bootstrap MEAN of the affine distance
of each resample's matrix, E_boot[ d_AI(M_boot) ]. Because d_AI is a norm it does not cancel, so the
mean of noisy resamples is biased UPWARD, and the bias matters precisely where the true distortion is
near the identity (IR, R): measured, IR's emitted affine is ~0.086 at N_ch 1e4 of which the signed
part (mean-log-eigenvalue) is 0.001 — essentially all of it is estimation-noise anisotropy. Taking the
affine of the bootstrap-MEAN matrix instead, d_AI( E_boot[M] ), smooths the sampling noise before the
norm and roughly halves it (IR 0.086 -> 0.046). This is the "compute it over the 10^4 together" fix:
same metric, one matrix per cell. For LSE/NR (distortion >> noise) the two agree to three digits. One
scalar per cell, so the rows are algorithm alone.

READING IT (measured, N_ch 1e4 noise 1): IR 0.10, R 0.70, LSE 4.75, NR 12.5 — the same cost ladder as
every panel of this figure set, now as a single honest number per cell. The split into what CAUSES
the distance (per-sample non-Gaussianity vs temporal correlation) is supplement 11.

Scale/plane/facet machinery shared from figure_4_common.R.
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r common, include=FALSE}
source("figure_4_common.R")
```

```{r scale}
# A distance >= 0; 0 = calibrated. NOT centred on 1 (that is the ratio's neutral, not the distance's),
# so purely sequential from ~0. Range measured 0.03 to 29. Log-spaced bands, floor 0.02 to avoid log(0).
AFF_LIN    <- c(0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 30)
AFF_BREAKS <- log10(AFF_LIN)
AFF_PAL    <- colorRampPalette(RAMP[7:13], space = "Lab")(length(AFF_LIN) - 1)
AFF_LAB    <- fmt_big(AFF_LIN)
AFF_SOL    <- 0.5     # noticeable whole-matrix miscalibration
AFF_DSH    <- 2       # severe
```

```{r data}
# d_AI( E_boot[M] ), computed from the aggregate distortion matrix (probit == mean = the bootstrap
# mean of each entry), NOT the emitted E_boot[d_AI]. p = matrix dim (LSE fixes i and Current_Noise).
NP <- c(nonlinearsqr = 4, macro_NR = 6, macro_R = 6, macro_IR = 6)
DIST_M <- "Probit_statistics_Likelihood_Gaussian_Information_Distortion"
aff_mat <- function(sub, p) {
  M <- matrix(NA, p, p)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sub))) M[sub$value_row[i] + 1, sub$value_col[i] + 1] <- sub$v[i]
  M <- (M + t(M)) / 2
  e <- eigen(M, symmetric = TRUE)$values
  if (any(!is.finite(e)) || any(e <= 0)) return(NA_real_)
  sqrt(sum(log(e)^2))
}
aff <- imap_dfr(GRID_BY_ALGO, function(g, a) if (!nrow(g)) tibble() else {
  p <- NP[[a]]
  pmap_dfr(g, function(nch, z) {
    read.csv(findf(nch, a, z, "battery_pool_G"), skip = 1) %>%
      filter(component_path == DIST_M, statistic == "value", probit == "mean") %>%
      group_by(interval_in_tau, value_row, value_col) %>% summarise(v = mean(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
      group_by(interval_in_tau) %>% group_modify(~ tibble(m = aff_mat(.x, p))) %>%
      mutate(algo = a, noise = z, Num_ch = nch)
  })
}) %>%
  filter(is.finite(m)) %>%
  mutate(param = "affine",
         lx = log10(interval_in_tau), ly = log10(as.numeric(noise)),
         nchf = factor(paste0("N[ch]==", Num_ch), levels = paste0("N[ch]==", NCHS)))

PARAM_MATH["affine"] <- "d[AI]"
cat("affine distance to identity by algorithm and noise (median over N_ch, interval):\n")
print(as.data.frame(aff %>% group_by(algo, noise) %>% summarise(m = median(m), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = algo, values_from = m)), row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
sat(log10(aff$m), min(AFF_BREAKS), max(AFF_BREAKS), "affine distance")
```

```{r render, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5.2}
hC <- map_height(1, 0.475)
g <- btitle("Whole-matrix distortion (affine distance of the Gaussian distortion to I)") /
     mapblock(aff, function(d) log10(d$m), AFF_PAL, AFF_BREAKS, "affine",
              top = TRUE, bottom = TRUE, iso_sol = log10(AFF_SOL), iso_dsh = log10(AFF_DSH)) /
     colorbar(AFF_PAL, AFF_LAB, "affine distance", AFF_LIN, sol = AFF_SOL, dsh = AFF_DSH)
hs <- c(0.16, hC, 0.28)
g <- g + plot_layout(heights = hs)
g
ggsave("Figure_4_supplement_10.pdf", g, width = 7.0, height = sum(hs))
```
